claims.supported: Evidence-aware Top-3 reranking improves the ordering of candidates already present in the initial Top-3.

data_protocol.development: RE1 system-OOF; each held-out system is predicted by models fit on the other two
data_protocol.external: 360 known external cases opened only after method freeze
data_protocol.external_role: post-hoc evaluation and pre-specified non-degradation guard

feature_schema.service_identifier_use: candidate matching key only; never a numeric model feature

limitations: The reranker cannot recover a true root cause ranked below Top-3 by the base M10C ranker.
RE1 has insufficient trace evidence, so trace-modality cross-domain transfer is not established.
Feature total_gain is predictive importance and must not be interpreted causally.
